articles.summary: EXTON, Pa. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 11, 2026-- Bentley Systems, Incorporated (Nasdaq: BSY) (the “Company”), the infrastructure engineering software company, today announced that its Board of Directors (the “Board”) declared a $0.07 per share dividend for the third quarter of 2026.
articles.title: Bentley Systems, Incorporated Declares Third Quarter 2026 Dividend
